title: Circles
subtitle: Understanding Circles and their Properties
subject: Mathematics
author: Shine Academy EduOS Content Team
learning_outcomes: Define a circle and its related terms: radius, diameter, chord, arc, secant, sector, segment.
Understand and prove properties of chords.
Understand the angle subtended by a chord at a point.
Learn about perpendicular from the centre to a chord.
Explore equal chords and their distances from the centre.
Understand the angle subtended by an arc of a circle.
Define and apply the properties of cyclic quadrilaterals.

ai_context.learning_goal: To provide a strong foundational understanding of circles, enabling students to logically deduce and prove geometric properties related to circles and cyclic quadrilaterals.
common_misconceptions: Confusing a sector with a segment.
Assuming all quadrilaterals inscribed in a circle are regular polygons.
Thinking the longest chord is not always the diameter.
Believing that angles in the same segment can be unequal.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If a student struggles with cyclic quadrilaterals, ask: 'What happens if we draw a circle passing through all four vertices? What do we know about the sum of the opposite angles?'
